abysmal: Abyss: bottomless. An abysmal performance: as bad as it gets.
Abysmal: the pit of a score.
antiquated: Antique + ated: out of date. An antiquated system.
aphorism: Aphorizein: define. “Less is more” is an aphorism.
balk: Balk: a ridge. The horse balked at the fence.
besiege: Be + siege: surround. Journalists besieged her.
colossal: Colossus: huge statue. A colossal mistake.
compound: Compound: combine; worsen. Compound interest; compound the error.
constraint: Con + stringere: bind. A budget constraint.
convivial: Con + vivere: live together. A convivial dinner.
cosmopolitan: Cosmos + polis: world city. A cosmopolitan city.
creditable: Credit: you earn it. A creditable result.
decimation: Decimus: tenth. Roman punishment. The plague decimated the town.
deliberate: De + librare: weigh. Deliberate over the verdict; a deliberate act.
differentiate: Differ: tell apart. Differentiate cat from dog.
dilapidated: De + lapis: stones come apart. A dilapidated house.
enumerate: E + numerare: count out. Enumerate the reasons.
evasive: E + vadere: slip away. An evasive answer.
excruciating: Ex + crux: from the cross. Excruciating pain.
inarticulate: In + articulate: can’t express. Inarticulate with rage.
inkling: Inkling: slight hint. No inkling of the danger.
malodorous: Mal + odor: bad smell. A malodorous drain.
misogynist: Miso + gyne: woman-hater. A misogynist remark.
morph: Metamorphosis: change. The caterpillar morphs into a butterfly.
perquisite: Perk. A company car is a perquisite.
provisional: Provision: for now. A provisional licence.
qualm: Qualm: doubt. No qualms about lying.
relegate: Re + legare: send away. Relegated to the minor league.
resignation: Resign: give up. Resignation at the news.
stymie: Stymie: block (golf). Stymied by red tape.
vie: Vie: compete. Vying for the prize.
